verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs describe in-product AI insights and suggestions across several surfaces. These include AI Summaries generated from incident data, a built-in Ask Rootly AI chat on the incident page, AI SRE that delivers a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps, related-incident matching, and AI-drafted retrospective sections. The same AI is also available on mobile and in Slack. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of these AI insights and suggestions, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
